svg.title: Building Governed Intelligence: Maddipalli Gopalakrishna, Agentic and RAG Architect
svg.desc: Construction blueprints, contracts and work orders feed an MCP retrieval tool and an agent router. Legal-intelligence and payment-risk agents produce a payment protection report and a compliance verification, and a human reviews and approves the result.

g.text: Source-grounded agents for construction payment protection
